# 工作区汇总

```query
from: 项目/
where: status = "进行中" and due < today + 7d
fields: 文件, owner, due, status
sort: due asc
limit: 20
view: table
```

```query
from: 项目/ or #工作
fields: 文件, owner, tags
group: status
view: list
```

```query
from: 项目/
view: count
```

```tasks
from: 工作/
status: open
due: before today + 7d
tag: #重要
group: file
sort: due
```
